chatlog-prune.settings.enabled.name: Enable Chat Log Pruning
chatlog-prune.settings.enabled.hint: Automatically remove old messages from the chat log DOM to improve performance. Messages are pruned when the count exceeds 50. Pruned messages can still be scrolled back to view.
chatlog-prune.settings.enableFiltering.h: Show a filter panel in the chat log to filter messages by player, actor, content, or title.
